_week: 2026-11-16 to 2026-11-22 (Week 47). Written from this week's numbers.
week_story: Orders rose 208% to 732. The lift began Thu Nov 19 ($3,484) and held through Sunday at $2,000+ a day. Every product grew: Variety 12 Pack $5,221 (+204%), Hazy IPA $2,094 (+283%), West Coast IPA $1,384 (+185%), Cherry Blossom $1,170 (+155%).
refunds: Refund money was $92.77 vs $118.02 last week, even with nearly 4x the units sold.
pacing_reco: At $1,016 a day, November projects to $30,471, ahead of October's $24,197. Keep the Nov 19 lift going into BF/CM with stock and coupons in place.
ads_context: ACoS fell to 46.5% from 69.4%; TACoS fell to 9.6% from 26.5%.
Spend eased 4.3% to $1,202 while ad sales rose 43% to $2,588, so each ad dollar returned $2.15 vs $1.44. Ads drove about 1 in 5 units.
ads_strategy: Category keywords: $1,033 for $2,126 (48.6% ACoS), 140 orders. Branded: $77 for $245 (31.5%).
Remarketing fell to $25.27 (from $139.10) but still returned only $8.99.
bid_moves: Lower bids on SB “non alcoholic beers” exact ($151.57 for $215.43) and SP “na beer” exact ($131.42 for $143.48).
Pause West Coast IPA “non alcoholic beer” exact: $70.19 for $40.44, and the item is out of stock.
coupons: Coupons ran on about 1 in 10 orders this week.
promotions: This week: 105 promotion orders and $552.45 in promotional discounts (vs $293.42 last week).
